definitions.ours_sun: mean visible fraction of the solar disc (radius 0.2666 deg), 2 m observer
definitions.ours_earth: share of 2-h steps with any part of the Earth disc above the horizon mask (topocentric; same as PGDA). The app uses the stricter Earth-centre rule - see alt_definitions.earth_centre
definitions.pgda: PGDA AVGVISIB maps (Mazarico et al. 2011), 18.6-year hourly averages, LDEM 60 m
definitions.horizon: pipeline/horizon.py, PGDA LOLA 60 m <= 60 km then 240 m <= 300 km, curvature
definitions.named_horizon: named sites: card 8 per-site horizons (web/data/horizon/<ID>.json, 5-240 m PGDA LOLA + LDEM chain); random points: pole-centred 60/240 m windows
